deleteDialog.title: Xóa {name}?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes {name} and everything in it: issues, bình luận, tệp đính kèm, and cài đặt. This cannot be undone.

leaveDialog.title: Leave {name}?
leaveDialog.description: You will lose access to {name} and its hạng mục công việc. To join again you need a new invite from an owner.

editDialog.title: Chỉnh sửa dự án
editDialog.keyHint: Issue links need a key of capital letters and digits that starts with a letter. After you lưu it, the key cannot change.
